items.title: 67251_Chuck Green oral history interview
items.q: I saw her as a child

ctx.x: Were there any new, aspiring new tap dancers stars coming along during this period that --

Yes. Rosemarie, Baby Rosemarie, she was one. She was one of the greatest female tapdancers, you know. See. She was in vaudeville, see, and a great time. I mean I saw her as a child, you see, and see when she was the only one that could do this, you see, there was -- she's a great fabricater I'll say, to use the word again, see -- she had this audience, she was an attraction, too, something to behold you see? The audience.
What was she doing then that was inspired the other dancers, or -- that you felt was helping to keep it alive?
